gates: edition only level 2 - correct edition not secured

edition.check: Level 5: Input contains a barcode -> NOT MET (input only specifies title and format MC). Level 4: Title, artist, format and further attributes unambiguous in >= 2 sources and no other edition fitting the input has a different tracklist -> NOT MET (input does not specify an artist, and tl-discogs search shows discogs:release/8491193 'Various - Ich Sag's Dir Mit Musik', a 1995 German GEMA Cassette Box Set compilation that fits the title and MC format with a different artist and tracklist, plus uninspected Polish MC discogs:release/16402359). Level 3: Unambiguous or all fitting editions share the same tracklist -> NOT MET (discogs:release/8491193 is a Various Artists compilation with a different tracklist that fits the input and was not ruled out or inspected). Level 2: Several editions fit the input and at least one has a different tracklist (other artist with the same title) -> MET (tl-discogs search returned discogs:release/8491193 alongside the Kastelruther Spatzen MC editions musicbrainz:release/e0d210c6-ca75-3482-bff4-f33715a070c3 and discogs:release/2297987).
edition.summary: Because the input omits the artist, the uninspected Various Artists cassette compilation discogs:release/8491193 with the same title also fits the input and has a different tracklist.
evidence: tl-discogs search --title "Ich sag's dir mit Musik"

tracklist.check: Level 5: >= 2 independent sources of the same edition agree on count, order and titles (spelling variants only) -> MET (musicbrainz:release/e0d210c6-ca75-3482-bff4-f33715a070c3 and discogs:release/2297987 represent the same 1985 Koch Records Special 221 190 cassette edition with barcode 9002722211901 and agree completely on all 12 tracks A1-B6 in count, order, and titles, differing only in capitalization).
tracklist.summary: Two independent database entries for the selected cassette edition agree on track count, order, and all 12 titles.

durations.check: 100% of tracks have a duration, 50% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 1 conflicts
durations.summary: 100% of tracks have a duration, 50% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 1 conflicts

sources.check: Level 5: Database + independent primary source of the same edition -> NOT MET (no primary source such as cover/label print or manufacturer sheet is included in the result sources; web:https://kastelrutherspatzen.de/merlin/taxonomy/term/26 was scraped but not cited and lacks edition-specific side/duration details). Level 4: Two independent database entries recognisable by differing details -> MET (musicbrainz:release/e0d210c6-ca75-3482-bff4-f33715a070c3 and discogs:release/2297987 show independent details including differing track durations on 10 of 12 tracks, catalog number formatting, country strings, and Discogs-only notes and images).
sources.summary: The result relies on two independent database entries for the same edition, distinguishable by differing durations, catalog formatting, and metadata.

concerns: Competing edition discogs:release/8491193 (Various - Ich Sag's Dir Mit Musik, 1995 Germany, Cassette Box Set Compilation) and discogs:release/16402359 (Poland, Cassette, AMA 074) from tl-discogs search were neither inspected nor listed in alternatives.
